content.description: VYRA offers a platform where Cardano users can connect and interact. The platform is free to use, with a focus on privacy and data protection. VYRA is a social network like Twitter based on #Cardano. June 1st 2024 ✅ Job System Voting for changes ($VYRA required) Schedule posts for Room Admins and Moderators. April 11th 2024 ✅ Launch VYRA 1.0 Desktop/APP. Q2 2023: ✅ Release of VYRA beta 1.1, featuring the first changes driven by the community. Q1 2023: ✅ Launch VYRA beta 1.0 / Desktop Version. Introduction VYRA is a social network that allows users to connect and share content with each other.
